user.title: Connect Hive EV
user.description: Sign in with your Hive account-owner login. This integration monitors your charger through Hive and keeps Hive scheduling in place. Your account password is used only during setup and is not saved.

sms.title: Verify Hive sign-in
sms.description: Enter the SMS verification code sent by Hive. If the code expires, cancel setup and sign in again.

remember.title: Remember Home Assistant in Hive
remember.description: Hive requires Home Assistant to be remembered as a trusted sign-in device for automatic token renewal. Confirm to register 'Home Assistant Hive EV' on your Hive account. This changes sign-in authorization only; charger settings and schedules are not changed. Sign-in tokens and a device key are saved in Home Assistant's configuration. You can cancel to leave setup unfinished.

data.remember_device: Register Home Assistant Hive EV as a trusted sign-in device

error.invalid_auth: Hive sign-in was rejected. Check the account-owner login and try again.
error.invalid_code: The verification code was rejected or the sign-in expired. Try again, or cancel and restart setup.
error.cannot_connect: Hive could not be reached. Try again later.
error.invalid_response: Hive returned unexpected monitoring data. Setup could not be completed.
error.remember_required: Confirm the trusted sign-in device registration to finish setup, or cancel.

abort.already_configured: This Hive account is already configured.
abort.no_chargers: No supported Hive EV charger was found on this account.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Hive account used for this integration.
